items.name: MultiConnector

items.name: TieringOffloadingSpec
items.why: with no secondary tiers it runs as its CPU primary tier: its spec sizing and policy calls are replayed here, and its manager calls by core/connector/tiering (inference-sim/blis-vllm#181)

items.name: example
items.why: refused by type, as every secondary tier is; an in-memory reference tier

items.name: fs
items.why: over the CPU primary tier; each job a transfer to or from the tier's device_class, priced on its offload_tier_<device>_* coefficients; the lookup worker and thread pool timed by named substitution (blis-vllm#190); store backpressure refused (blis-vllm#13)

items.name: p2p
items.why: over the CPU primary tier; the engine is a Peered: the tier's control messages travel as the simulator's peer messages and each WRITE is a store between pools priced from its Move, to the endpoint the simulator placed the peer at (PlacePeer); the message delivery latency and the WRITE's duration are the simulator's, and a session that is only idle is polled at the next message or call rather than on the poll thread's schedule (blis-vllm#204); only the UCX data plane, store backpressure refused (blis-vllm#13)

items.name: obj
items.why: over the CPU primary tier; each job one NIXL OBJ transfer, a transfer to or from the tier's device_class priced on its offload_tier_<device>_* coefficients, which are scenario inputs (blis-vllm#184); the probe worker timed by named substitution (blis-vllm#190); store backpressure refused (blis-vllm#13)
